clauses.text:
NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
(SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DOCUMENT FOR TESTING — FICTITIOUS PARTIES)
This Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into between Periyar Robotics Private Limited (the "Disclosing Party") and Bluewave Consulting (the "Receiving Party").

clauses.title: Confidential Information
clauses.text: Confidential Information means all information of any kind disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether oral, written or electronic, whether or not marked confidential.

clauses.title: Obligations of the Receiving Party
clauses.text: The Receiving Party shall not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party and shall use it only to evaluate a possible software development project.

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: The obligations of the Receiving Party shall continue indefinitely and shall survive termination of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Non-Solicitation and Non-Compete
clauses.text: The Receiving Party shall not provide services to any competitor of the Disclosing Party for a period of three (3) years after the termination of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Remedies
clauses.text: In case of any breach, the Receiving Party shall pay liquidated damages of Rs. 25,00,000 to the Disclosing Party, in addition to any other remedy.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: The Disclosing Party may terminate this Agreement at any time without notice.

clauses.title: Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: The Receiving Party waives any right to approach any court. All disputes shall be decided by an arbitrator nominated by the Disclosing Party.
